decisions.decision: Show the ribbon through individually tinted notebook sections and lighter nested cards. Use a denser tint for floating labels and controls, and solid notebook colors for reduced transparency.
Pair the slate-blue folder tab and plain paper inserts with the glass hinge and file fan. Show compact project rows with single-line names and inline details.
Display PDFs in the Safari-01 frame with a blank address bar and a resizable portrait reading area. Overlay reading controls on the document.
Use the liquid-glass pill for section navigation and project paths, with animated reflections, tap ripples, and Hugeicons.
Use the GitHub activity palette for the résumé builder card. Layer the landing page’s typographic globe behind its floating figure, with a static globe for reduced motion.
Use translucent navy behind GitHub activity and a shared slate-blue to ice-cyan contribution scale for the calendar and contact preview.
Render Arda's portrait as a detailed grid of 240 × 320 color tiles. The image loops automatically without controls.

Use the homepage ribbon and navbar with pastel folded post-its. Set link titles in bold Caveat and unfold newly saved notes using PaperCrumple. Movement across the sheet flexes it, and visitors can drag notes into their own arrangement.
